author: DaveUrkel (BlackWhitePU)
text_post: All of these are really unnecessary. They sound cool and everything, which is why people in the community like to try to use them, but in reality, the best way to handle a girl saying she has a bf is to ignore it. Its a lot more marketable for pick-ups companies to give you these cool-sounding lines than it is to tell you to just ignore it, but the truth is ignoring it will be a lot more effective. And if the girl keeps bringing up her boyfriend, then usually no line or even no amount of ignoring it will help. Sometimes you just gotta move on to the next girl.
